kind: source-only prospective fold positive-zero reach census
arms: Two independent ordinary GpuSolver instances share immutable Spot only; unchanged 20-iteration/exploitability schedule. No kernel, graph, event, evaluator or production method changes. Fixture instances are released before next fixture.
snapshot_position: After complete paired iteration and before either arm exploitability. E015 retained reach1 is the exact last p0 fold input, retained reach0 the exact last p1 fold input; not arbitrary current-strategy reaches.
snapshot_reads: Only d_reach[0/1] at20/final, chunk_floats=1048576, paired bitwise equality, max8MiB float snapshot. No intermediate regret/strategy arena reads. Metadata is independently compared once with uploaded arrays for both arms.
logical_mapping: Every flattened fold_nodes entry counted once per traverser. Opponent q=1-p; physical start=reach_slot[q][node]*nh[q], exactly nh[q] words. Bounds, complete contiguous fold spans, node kind and uploaded metadata must match. No uniqueness assumption; no padding or non-fold rows counted as fold work.

row_flags.combination: flags independent and preserved across readback chunks; mixed rows may enter multiple category counts

eligibility: Report all+0 fold CTA incidence separately from all+0 with finite selected f32 amount: node_player[n]==p ? node_tlose[n] : node_twin[n]. No inference that output is +0 or that stores can be skipped.
evidence: Create-new per-fixture binary fold mapping: five little-endian u32 words per CTA (node,slot0,slot1,amount0bits,amount1bits), JSON level spans, plus one byte per physical row per player/snapshot. Keep complete reach-word category totals and FNV hashes. Raw reach float payloads are not retained. Runner additionally SHA256-pins files.
controls: 23 checkpoints per arm must match immutable E020C1 and original B065 exploit bits; six paired reach snapshots exact; final complete compressed q/scale arrays compared bitwise for both players and both stores, then complete final evaluator fingerprint equals immutable anchors. Full CPU stores are independent of compact device arena sizes.
memory: D045 exact planned device payload preflight for two arms plus2GiB device reserve. Before Spot16GiB free host; after Spot+plan two CPU stores, two pinned buffers,8MiB reach snapshot, compact geometry+rowflags plus8GiB reserve. Sequential fixtures. Fail closed, no smaller alternative fixture.
no_claims: fraction of dynamic work over all iterations
failure_policy: One fixed invocation; preserve every failure and completed observation. No retry, resampling, extension or outcome-driven selection. CUDA/numerical/mapping errors fail closed.
